justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a proper enum with distinguishing variants including a char-carrying InvalidCharacter, though the lookup table uses raw (u32, &str) tuples rather than a dedicated struct.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants (OutOfRange, Empty, InvalidCharacter, NotCanonical), no panics in library code, and unwraps appear only in tests.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives and Display are present, but no doc comments on any public items (functions, error type, or variants) and no std::error::Error implementation.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with iterator usage and proper match, but uses an index-based for loop over values and could leverage windows/zip and matches! more expressively.
